ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution accounting for approximately 90% of the surface area, contrasted by 10% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized in linear and circular formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base-layer across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white linear streaks are distributed across the mid-section of both lobes. Tan-colored, high-texture clusters are fixed to the distal tips (lobes' furthest lateral points).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex; depth constitutes approximately 20% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the entire boundary. Notable jagged peaks localized on the upper-right trailing edge and the upper-left corner.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5-2.0% of total fluke width) distributed along the peripheral margins and concentrated heavily on the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, high-contrast white linear streaks; one prominent diagonal mark on the left lobe and a dense network of intersecting horizontal rake marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured brown-to-tan biological clusters (barnacles) attached to the extreme distal edges of both lobes; several circular white depigmentation scars consistent with barnacle removal sites.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, diffused, medium-intensity gray/white patch located in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe lobe.
